deadEnd.details: 2026-10-07 through the staging proxy (local egress): the flight search's POST wwws.airfrance.co.uk/gql/v1 answered 403 and the Search button spun forever, so no fares, and no checkout, are reachable. The same refusal on both Air France and KLM (one Air France-KLM bot manager); no CAPTCHA was shown.

gotchas: Booking runs on market hosts such as wwws.airfrance.co.uk and wwws.airfrance.fr/en; same Air France-KLM booking widget as klm.co.uk.
Cookie wall on load: click the 'Reject' button.

The From/To comboboxes expose no CSS-fillable <input>; focus the combobox (aria-label From / To), send the airport code as single key presses, then click the option such as 'From London Heathrow Airport LHR' or 'To Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport CDG'. Trip type is the 'Trip' combobox with a 'One-way' option.
Search deep link that pre-fills the widget: /search/offers?pax=1:0:0:0:0:0:0:0&cabinClass=ECONOMY&activeConnection=0&connections=LHR:A:20261023%3ECDG:A&bookingFlow=LEISURE.

Blocking (2026-10-02, staging proxy, local egress): once both airports are set, the 'Search flights' button turns into a spinner that never finishes and the Departure date picker never opens, on the UK and FR markets and on the deep link alike (40 s+ waits). No offers page was reached. Likely a bot-score gate on the booking API, as on klm.co.uk.
The permanent search spinner is a 403 from /gql/v1 (bot manager), shared with klm.co.uk.
